summary: Validator for plan toolchain-workflow-repair; requires plan under execution-plans with 14 artifacts/tools; contract self-hosted and slices W0-W6, all TDD; registry must include plan-ready, terminal-full, and green/terminal commands per slice; authority partitions required; draft/plan-ready/authorized-repair state gates enforce no authorization; plan-ready publication must bind validation receipt hash; resume, architecture acceptance, pre-existing delta commits/paths/hashes, knowledge preflight/freeze, and accepted modules skill-input-execution plus knowledge-execution-gates are mandatory; canonical skill-input receipt is required, inside plan/skill-input, and must validate ready; authorized-repair-revalidate requires implementation-authorized plus validating repair state blocked with empty authorizations; output pass/fail validation receipt, always authorizes none and lifecycle transition none; optional output also writes validator input manifest; ambiguity: plan-state.v1.json is read but absent from required-file list.
